items.title: Lightning Labs Urges Immediate Updates Over Certificate Vulnerability
items.summary: New binaries block trust in compromised eMudhra certificate keys.

items.title: Bitcoin hashrate hits seven-month high as AI shift fails to ease mining competition
items.summary: According to BlocksBridge, Bitcoin’s mining difficulty is rising despite the industry’s AI transition, with smaller operators potentially absorbing equipment abandoned by larger competitors.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Erase October Losses With $1 Billion in Three Days
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs have drawn about $1.07 billion over three sessions, pushing October flows to a gain of roughly $460 million, even as Bitcoin and Ethereum prices slipped.

items.title: Irish central bank fines Coinbase Ireland $3.6 million over fund safeguarding failures
items.summary: When Silvergate was on the verge of collapse in 2023, Coinbase instructed 30 customers to deposit funds into an alternate account held by Coinbase at another U.S.
